objective: Update the existing tutorial for current cruush 1.6 features, expose a safe dev-only onboarding walkthrough without real email, award tutorial completion as a side quest, give cruush+ unlimited Pulses with a three-hour cooldown while preventing repeat same-sender Pulse delivery within 24 hours, expand Pulse copy, and repair the named mobile cruush, messages, and feed layout issues.
userOutcome: Members understand cruush+, Mile High Club, and Pulse behavior; developers can review onboarding locally without an account; tutorial completion earns a side-quest reward; cruush+ members can Pulse again after three hours without repeatedly reaching the same person; and named mobile pages have centered controls, hidden scrollbars, and one-line headers.
audience: cruush members and local developers reviewing onboarding.
successCriteria: The map tutorial includes current cruush+, Mile High Club, Feed, Spots, and Pulse explanations.
A dev-only public onboarding preview runs without sign-in and does not write profile, 2FA, code-of-conduct, reward, or session data.
Completing, not skipping, the map tutorial records the tutorial side quest through the existing rewards path.
cruush+ Pulse allowance has no daily limit and enforces a three-hour cooldown; Basic remains one Pulse per 24 hours.

A recipient is not selected for another Pulse from the same sender within a rolling 24 hours while existing visibility, mutuality, blocks, freshness, radius, and notification preferences remain unchanged.
Pulse copy explains duration, visibility, feed behavior, recipient limits, cooldowns, and the saved profile signal.
The mobile cruush page hides the visual vertical scrollbar and centers counts and tabs.
Cruush, messages, and feed mobile headers keep back, title, settings where present, and bug button on one line without overlap.
mustPreserve: Preserve map tiles and theme, Ghost Mode and Dark Room behavior, current Pulse radius/duration/eligibility/privacy behavior, current onboarding sequence, bottom navigation, badges, photos, and unrelated UI.
Keep the no-email onboarding route unavailable in production and make preview completion side-effect-free.
Keep page scrolling functional while hiding only the visible mobile cruush scrollbar.
nonGoals: Do not add reactions, feed replies, crowd-mode changes, new navigation, new Pulse radii or duration, global scrollbar changes, tests, builds, email changes, or deployment.
Do not redesign adjacent desktop layouts or change headers outside Cruush, Messages, and Feed.

assumptions.statement: Per day means the existing rolling 24-hour Pulse window.
assumptions.impact: Repeat Pulse alerts from the same sender remain suppressed for 24 hours.

assumptions.statement: Unlimited cruush+ Pulses means no daily quota, while one active Pulse and the three-hour cooldown still apply.
assumptions.impact: cruush+ members can send another Pulse after three hours without a daily cap.

nextVisibleMilestone: Render the dev onboarding walkthrough, map tutorial, Pulse panel, and named mobile headers for review.
stopConditions: Stop for an unsafe schema requirement, a conflicting dirty edit in a named file, or unavailable local rendering dependencies after checking the existing owned server.

externalEffectDecisions.commit: authorized by the standing request to commit while completing the 1.6 todo

job: Implement the scoped tutorial, onboarding preview, side quest, Pulse rules/copy, and named mobile layout changes, then checkpoint commit.
proofTarget: Rendered local dev-only onboarding preview without authentication, rendered tutorial cruush+/MHC steps, rendered Pulse copy and state, and Android-size Cruush/Messages/Feed headers and centered Cruush controls.
requiredEvidence: The public dev preview route opens signed out and completing it does not call protected APIs.
The tutorial visibly includes cruush+ and Mile High Club and completion records its side quest.
The Pulse UI states the three-hour cruush+ cooldown and 24-hour same-sender recipient limit.
The named mobile routes show one-line headers without overlap and Cruush centers counts/tabs without a visible scrollbar.
